fact: Digital Business Africa reports TCHADIX, Chad's internet exchange point run by ADETIC as an economic interest group (GIE), has been operational for a year, with internet access providers and mobile operators attending its members' general assembly opened on 20 May 2026; no member count is given.
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Chad, N'Djamena IX, with 9 members as of November 2026.
ISOC Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 exchange point in Chad with 8 of 18 networks peering.
ISOC Pulse says Chad has one active IXP that connects a third of the country's networks, and that no content delivery network operates caches there.
Internet Society Pulse says Chad has one IXP managed by ADETIC, with at least nine networks peering there per PeeringDB, almost all visible networks in Chad.
